topics.title: 课程作业与教师授权
topics.summary: 图书馆学生指南指示学生在使用生成式AI前须征得任课教师或导师同意；作业许可依课程培养目标而定。
topics.scope: 所有本科与研究生授课型课程
topics.evidenceScope: All undergraduate and graduate taught courses

claims.text: Library student guidance instructs students to check with their teacher or supervisor before using GenAI tools, noting that curricula and faculty rules govern permitted use.

evidence.quote: However, before using GenAI tools, make sure you check with your teacher or supervisor whether you are allowed to use GenAI
evidence.title: GenAI for students - Leiden University

topics.title: 考试考核与AI量表

topics.scope: 课程正式考试、测验与考核
topics.evidenceScope: Formal exams, tests, and module assessments

evidence.quote: Level 4: AI task completion, human evaluation

topics.title: AI使用声明附录
topics.summary: 化学研究所硕士论文指引要求附加强制性'AI使用声明'附录，详细记录工具、提示词、目的及与导师沟通情况。
topics.scope: 莱顿化学研究所（LIC）理学硕士研究项目
topics.evidenceScope: Leiden Institute of Chemistry (LIC) MSc research projects

claims.text: LIC MSc guidelines mandate an appendix 'Declaration of AI Use' in theses and research reports, requiring students to document tools, prompts, purposes, and supervisory agreement.

evidence.quote: Your MSc thesis or essay must include an appendix: Declaration of AI Use.
evidence.title: Guidelines on responsible and transparent use of AI tools in written reports (LIC)

topics.title: 保密规范与Openbaar标签
topics.summary: 大学员工安全规范规定仅有带'Openbaar'（公开）标签的文档方可输入AI工具；严禁输入个人与保密数据。
topics.scope: 大学官方文档与教职工数字工作空间
topics.evidenceScope: University documents and employee digital workspaces

claims.text: Staff security guidance specifies that only documents labelled 'Openbaar' (Public) may be shared with AI tools; personal or confidential institutional data is prohibited.

evidence.quote: Alleen documenten met het label ‘Openbaar’ mag je delen met een AI-tool.
evidence.title: Werken met AI - Universiteit Leiden staff
